_readme: Templates for pages generated from data (players, pokemon, events, trophies, themes). Placeholders use {name}. 'parent' is the real listing page used for breadcrumbs, because the /player/, /pokemon/, /event/ and /trophy/ index URLs do not exist.

player.title: {name}'s Shinies | Team Synergy - PokeMMO
player.description: {name} has caught {count} shiny Pokemon in PokeMMO. Browse {name}'s Team Synergy shiny collection, favourites and stats.

pokemon.title: {name} Shiny Dex | Type: {types} | Team Synergy - PokeMMO
pokemon.description: {name} ({types}) - Tier: {tier}{generation}. View {name} details, shiny form, location, and abilities in Team Synergy's PokeMMO Pokédex.

event.title: {name} | Team Synergy - PokeMMO
event.description: Join the {name} event in PokeMMO, a Team Synergy community event. See details, dates and how to take part.
event.descriptionSuffix: A Team Synergy PokeMMO community event - see details, dates and how to take part.

trophy.title: {name} Trophy | Team Synergy - PokeMMO
trophy.description: See which Team Synergy members earned the {name} trophy in PokeMMO.

theme.title: {name} | PokeMMO Theme by {author} | Team Synergy
theme.description: {name} is a PokeMMO theme by {author} in the {category} category. Download and customize your game!
theme.descriptionSuffix: A PokeMMO theme by {author} shared on Team Synergy - preview it and download it free.
